def_meta.display_name: Veritas Intelligence Analytics Governance Unified YAML
def_meta.purpose: Single governance file for UDC, I/O, regex hardgate, VRN report extraction, financial SSOT, UI schema, environment policy, and validation.

policy_summary.immutable: Only the three Taiwan stock ticker types and their cross-format relationship are fixed.
policy_summary.editable: All other regex, broker/rating/target price aliases, financial accounts, rescue rules, UI, I/O, and environment rules can be added or modified through anchored YAML-AST patching.
policy_summary.testing: Every editable change should pass parse, anchor, regex, and domain-specific validation before runtime adoption.

deployment_strategy_from_notion.log_policy: write console log and deployment log directory with timestamp

def_anchor_index.required_anchor_policy: Every editable/immutable domain section must carry anchor_id, yaml_path, mutability, owner_engine, validation_hooks.

def_yaml_ast_patch_contract.policy: Patch by anchor_id + yaml_path only. Never patch by fuzzy display labels.

def_hardgate_taiwan_stock_ticker_identit.description: Three types of Taiwan stock tickers and their cross-format relationship are fixed. These are the only immutable data-format rules in this YAML.

TW_TICKER_REGEX.description_zh: 屬於 TICKER 的一種；四碼數字；第一碼不可為 0；不可為 2021~2030。

TW_YFINANCE_REGEX.description_zh: 屬於 YFINANCE TICKER 的一種；TWSE 用 .TW；TPEX 用 .TWO；若交易所不明確，自動換碼測試。

TW_BLOOMBERG_REGEX.description_zh: 屬於 BLOOMBERG TICKER 的一種；格式為四碼代號 + 空格 + TT。
